question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
-- Compute the median of the highest season goals per team
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY highest_season_goals) AS median_highest_season_goals
FROM (
    SELECT team_api_id, MAX(total_goals) AS highest_season_goals
    FROM (
        SELECT team_api_id, season, SUM(total_goals) AS total_goals
        FROM (
            SELECT home_team_api_id AS team_api_id, season, SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_goals
            FROM Match
            GROUP BY home_team_api_id, season
            UNION ALL
            SELECT away_team_api_id AS team_api_id, season, SUM(away_team_goal) AS total_goals
            FROM Match
            GROUP BY away_team_api_id, season
        )
        GROUP BY team_api_id, season
    )
    GROUP BY team_api_id
)
